title: Jensen Is Gone. The AI Rotation Isn’t.
author: MochiHill
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/fd07um9hzd1i1.png

Apple just notched fresh highs, AMD and Broadcom caught that post-CoreWeave lift, while Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet kept mega-cap names steady. The Nasdaq 100 jumped nearly 5% — the market didn’t ditch AI, it just rotated right within the sector. Nvidia still had everyone’s full attention, with leadership headlines piling on pressure but cash still flowing all across the AI ecosystem. Tesla and smaller growth plays didn’t get the same pass, with higher yields keeping duration pinned under pressure. Anyone else just holding steady and riding this rotation out [calmly?](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004523789?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)

comments.author: Old-Grab-3561
comments.body: honestly feels like everyone is trying to overcomplicate a pretty standard sector rotation. money is just moving around the same big names instead of leaving the trade entirely.

comments.author: Stunning_Room7648
comments.body: I think this rotation is healthy—the AI story hasn't broken, just the way it rallies changed. Holding leaders beats chasing every hot spot.
